comparison.objective: Measure shaft end play, select a spacer, install it, and verify fit and rotation.
comparison.physical_skill: Indicator probing, tolerance interpretation, thin-part insertion, and post-installation verification.
comparison.success_condition: Correct spacer yields acceptable clearance and free rotation; the record omits numeric tolerance bands.
comparison.reason: It is measurement-driven part selection and fitting, not direct adjustment and jam-nut preservation of a stop.
